title: AXM command result schemas
description: Validate a command-specific result using its route reference. Diagnostic-record contents remain unfrozen support artifacts.

AxmSupport.title: AXM Support
AxmSupport.description: AXM-owned integration status for an agent capability. This is not a vendor fact.

LastVerifiedDate.title: Last Verified Date
LastVerifiedDate.description: Date a capability claim was last verified.

CatalogReview.description: Documented claim review, independent of AXM or vendor runtime execution.

AgentProfile.description: Scoped product identity and research; it does not certify every capability.

Scope.title: Scope
Scope.description: Where a capability can be configured.

VendorStatus.title: Vendor Status
VendorStatus.description: Vendor or plugin health for the surface named by availability.

DocLink.title: Documentation Link
DocLink.description: Documentation reference for an agent or capability.

HookMechanismFamily.title: Hook Mechanism Family
HookMechanismFamily.description: How a native hook system invokes a hook.

AxmVerification.description: Attributable evidence of AXM configuration output or actual vendor runtime use.

AgentLifecycleState.title: Agent Lifecycle State
AgentLifecycleState.description: Support status of the coding agent product itself. Distinct from AxmSupport, which tracks AXM's integration with a single capability.

ErrorCode.title: Error Code
ErrorCode.description: Error category shared by plan failures and CLI envelopes.

TelemetryFailureRequest.description: Bounded evidence from the failed Registry request attempt. Request identity is correlation, never authorization or an idempotency key.

TelemetryFailureFrame.description: A source location verified against the reporting AXM build. No absolute path, function text, source excerpt, variables, or extension code is carried.

ErrorCause.title: Error Cause
ErrorCause.description: One serialized entry from a failure's cause chain.

ExtensionType.title: Extension Type
ExtensionType.description: What kind of extension this is: skill, mcp-server, subagent, rule, hook, knowledge, or pack.

ConfiguredAgentReasonCode.description: Published reasons for a configured-agent lifecycle outcome.

OwnershipUnitAddress.description: An entry, key path, region, or whole file; key names never become ambiguous path fragments.

ConfiguredAgentOutcome.title: Configured Agent Outcome
ConfiguredAgentOutcome.description: Effective lifecycle result for one configured agent and extension.

NativeLocationOutcome.description: One resolved native unit with its aliases, consumers, ownership evidence, and observed or planned change.

InstallableExtensionType.title: Installable Extension Type
InstallableExtensionType.description: Extension types supported by install-oriented CLI and registry flows.

WorkspaceLockfileVersionUnsupportedProbl.title: Unsupported Workspace Lockfile Version
WorkspaceLockfileVersionUnsupportedProbl.description: Identifies an unsupported workspace lockfile version and its direction.

FailureProblem.title: Failure Problem
FailureProblem.description: Structured details for a recognized failure.

HumanHandoffAction.title: Human handoff
HumanHandoffAction.description: A pending human action and instructions to resume the same request. URLs and references are display data, not authority to execute commands or exchange credentials.

JsonErrorEnvelope.title: JSON Error Envelope
JsonErrorEnvelope.description: Structured JSON error envelope for machine-readable CLI error output.

ResolvedConceptRef.title: Resolved Knowledge Concept Reference
ResolvedConceptRef.description: Logical concept identity resolved to one bundle and content revision.

KnowledgeQuery.title: Knowledge Query
KnowledgeQuery.description: Canonical, serializable Knowledge discovery query model.

ConceptRef.title: Knowledge Concept Reference
ConceptRef.description: Logical Knowledge concept identity: bundle FQN plus concept ID.

LintInput.title: Lint Input
LintInput.description: Filesystem identity evaluated by the lint run.

LintFindingGroup.title: Lint Finding Group
LintFindingGroup.description: Rule catalog the finding came from.

LintJsonLocation.title: Lint Finding Location
LintJsonLocation.description: Document-relative location a finding points at.

LintJsonFinding.title: Lint Finding
LintJsonFinding.description: A single lint finding with its rule, severity, and rendered path.

LintExitCategory.title: Lint Exit Category
LintExitCategory.description: Whether the run has errors, has warnings without errors, or is clean of both; informational findings remain clean.

LintJsonSummary.title: Lint Summary
LintJsonSummary.description: Finding counts by severity plus the derived exit category.

LintJsonDocument.title: Lint Document
LintJsonDocument.description: Machine-readable result of an `axm lint` run.

DeprecationMessage.description: Optional publisher notes for consumers of a deprecated extension.

DeprecationReplacement.description: Authorization-safe current availability of a recorded replacement identity.

OperationOutcome.title: Operation Outcome
OperationOutcome.description: Canonical terminal outcome of a plan-family operation.

AtomicityClass.title: Atomicity Class
AtomicityClass.description: Failure-atomicity class of an operation's durable effects.

OperationAtomicity.title: Operation Atomicity
OperationAtomicity.description: The atomicity class the operation declared and the class that actually applied.

BlockingClass.title: Blocking Class
BlockingClass.description: Bounded reason class for work that did not proceed.

OperationPhase.title: Operation Phase
OperationPhase.description: Lifecycle phase of a plan-family operation.

OperationBlock.title: Operation Block
OperationBlock.description: A typed blocking condition: reason class, blocked subject, phase, and the escape that resolves it.

OperationFailure.title: Operation Failure
OperationFailure.description: Typed failure cause for an operation or unit that failed.

UnitDisposition.title: Unit Disposition
UnitDisposition.description: What became of a unit's durable effects after termination.

OperationInterruption.title: Operation Interruption
OperationInterruption.description: External termination and the durable-state disposition it left.

UnitCounts.title: Unit Counts
UnitCounts.description: Reconciling unit-state counts: the state buckets partition the unit set and sum to total; warnings counts annotations.

UnitState.title: Unit State
UnitState.description: Canonical lifecycle state of one unit of work.

StepArtifactTarget.title: Plan Step Artifact Target
StepArtifactTarget.description: One materialized target surface for a plan step artifact.

StepArtifactSource.title: Plan Step Artifact Source
StepArtifactSource.description: Optional source metadata describing where the artifact came from.

StepManagedRegion.title: Plan Step Managed Region
StepManagedRegion.description: One managed-region ownership unit and its provenance owner.

StepArtifact.title: Plan Step Artifact
StepArtifact.description: Optional artifact metadata describing what changed and where.

Unit.title: Operation Unit
Unit.description: One unit of work in a resolved operation, in its canonical state.

FootprintEntry.title: Footprint Entry
FootprintEntry.description: One observed durable change or restoration.

OperationRecovery.title: Operation Recovery
OperationRecovery.description: Machine-readable recovery content: retained durable state, preserved pre-change snapshots, and resolving actions. Never blocks a later invocation.

ReleaseAgeRecord.title: Release Age Record
ReleaseAgeRecord.description: One deterministic minimum-release-age holdback or bypass record.

OperationPrecondition.title: Operation Precondition
OperationPrecondition.description: A condition that must be satisfied before an operation can apply.

AgentCoverage.title: Agent Coverage
AgentCoverage.description: Configured agents for which a settled unit observed a retained materialization; native runtime availability is reported separately.

CatalogExtensionType.title: Catalog Extension Type
CatalogExtensionType.description: Non-pack extension types represented by the AgentXM registry.

TargetedUpdateContext.title: Targeted Update Context
TargetedUpdateContext.description: Sanitized ownership, authority, constraint, closure, and state-effect facts.

PlanResolutionResult.title: Plan Resolution Result
PlanResolutionResult.description: Resolved plan-family operation: canonical outcome, typed blocking, atomicity, reconciling counts, and identity-ordered units.

PlanResolutionDocument.title: Plan Resolution Document
PlanResolutionDocument.description: Top-level machine-output payload for a resolved AXM operation.

PublishMode.title: Publish Mode
PublishMode.description: Whether the publish command previewed or applied the reconciliation decisions.

Handle.title: Handle
Handle.description: A unique username or organization name starting with @, like @my-org.

ExtensionName.title: Extension Name
ExtensionName.description: The name of an extension — lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (e.g. my-skill).

PublishReason.title: Publish Reason
PublishReason.description: Reason a publish item was skipped or errored.

Version.title: Version
Version.description: A semver version like 1.0.0. Ranges are not allowed here.

ExtensionVisibility.title: Extension Visibility
ExtensionVisibility.description: Whole-Extension Registry visibility applied to every published version.

PublishVisibility.title: Publish Visibility
PublishVisibility.description: Authoritative whole-Extension visibility and provenance resolved for a publication.

SourceType.title: Source Type
SourceType.description: Source type discriminator: git, registry, local, inline, or workspace.

PublishAction.title: Publish Action
PublishAction.description: Publish reconciliation decision for an extension version.

PublishPhase.title: Publish Phase
PublishPhase.description: Publish lifecycle phase that produced an item outcome.

PublishStatus.title: Publish Status
PublishStatus.description: Execution status for an applied publish decision.

PublishCause.title: Publish Cause
PublishCause.description: Redacted typed cause for an operation that actually failed.

PublishAdvisoryFinding.title: Publish Advisory Finding
PublishAdvisoryFinding.description: A non-gating structured warning observed during publication.

PublishResultItem.title: Publish Result Item
PublishResultItem.description: Structured result for one publish reconciliation item.

RegistryTransition.title: Registry transition
RegistryTransition.description: The acknowledged before/after state and revision of a non-restorable Registry write, discriminated by action.

ExtensionVisibility_1.title: Extension Visibility
ExtensionVisibility_1.description: Intended whole-Extension Registry visibility. Establishes new Extensions and must match established Extensions.

anyOf.description: Ordered, case-sensitive Git-style package-path allowlist. Omission uses repository .gitignore patterns; an explicit array bypasses Git ignores. [] selects only the required manifest, ["**"] selects all permitted content. Positive rules include and ! rules remove paths. This affects only Registry distribution.

Ordered, case-sensitive Git-style exclusions applied after default or explicit inclusion. ! restores a path unless a parent remains excluded. [] adds no exclusions. Excluding the required manifest is an error. Installation, import, fork, and projection are unchanged.

PublishOptions.title: Publish Options
PublishOptions.description: Publication policy and archive options for this extension.

anyOf.description: Subdirectory within the repository, for monorepo publishers.

Repository.title: Repository
Repository.description: Source repository for this extension. Accepts a URL string (or `host:owner/repo` shorthand) or an object with `type`, `url`, and optional `directory`.

Bugs.title: Bugs
Bugs.description: Where to report bugs against this extension. Accepts a URL string or an object with optional `url` and `email`.

Author.title: Author
Author.description: A person credited as a creator or maintainer of this extension.

PackageIdentityPurl.title: Package Identity Purl
PackageIdentityPurl.description: A Package URL (purl) identity for a companion package. Companion package purls are identities, not pins: omit the purl @version segment and put compatibility constraints in versionRange.

CompanionPackage.title: Companion Package
CompanionPackage.description: A companion package purl identity with an optional VERS compatibility range.

PackSpec.title: Pack Spec
PackSpec.description: Pack reference with an optional version constraint suffix.

ConfigurableAgentId.title: Configurable Agent ID
ConfigurableAgentId.description: Supported coding agent identifier used in workspace settings `agents`.

VersionRange.title: Version Range
VersionRange.description: A semver version range like ^1.0.0, ~2.3.0, >=1.0.0 <3.0.0, or an exact version 1.2.3. Use "*" to always resolve to the latest available version.

HookEvent.description: Exact event name in the implementation's native host protocol.

HookRuntime.description: Interpreter family used to execute this native command handler.

HookPackagePath.description: A safe, package-relative POSIX file path. Absolute paths and traversal are forbidden.

HookBlockOutcome.title: Hook Block Outcome
HookBlockOutcome.description: Decision outcome available to blocking hook systems.

HookModifyOperation.title: Hook Modify Operation
HookModifyOperation.description: Transform operation available to modifying hook systems.

HookBindingRequirements.description: Every declared outcome and operation must be supported by this native event. Omit for observation only.

HookFixture.description: Native stdin and expected output files used only by explicitly requested fixture execution.

anyOf.title: Extension Metadata
anyOf.description: Opaque consumer-defined JSON metadata. The compact UTF-8 JSON representation is limited to 65,536 bytes and container depth 16.
Short, registry-facing summary of this extension shown in listings and search results.

anyOf.title: License
anyOf.description: SPDX license expression, or `UNLICENSED` for proprietary code.
External ecosystem packages this extension is designed to work with, declared as identity Package URLs with optional VERS compatibility ranges.
Soft capability enhancements used by the source. These never block installation.
Hard capabilities without which the extension cannot operate.
Pack recommendations and same-pack composition metadata. Entries do not install or guarantee the pack or its members.
False means the extension requires sibling extensions that are direct members of a pack named in recommendedPacks, resolved by extension identity rather than by path; it does not create dependencies.

VisibilityRevision.description: Opaque revision for conditional whole-Extension visibility mutation.

eventId.description: Report identity, fresh per report and unchanged when the same report is resubmitted.

invocationId.description: Identity of the client process invocation that failed.

errorClass.title: Error Class
errorClass.description: Classifies whether a failure is an AXM defect, a user-correctable failure, or an external dependency failure.

phase.title: Failure Phase
phase.description: The invocation phase that settled with the failure: bootstrap, workspace configuration, command execution, or output writing.

handled.description: False when the failure is an unexpected defect rather than an expected error.

command.description: Canonical command identity when known, for example `extensions install`. Never arguments.

activityId.description: Product activity correlation identity when the invocation started one.

anyOf.description: Report identity, fresh per report and unchanged when the same report is resubmitted.
